breakdown.description: With 60 vol% fibers at 230 GPa, the longitudinal modulus cannot fall below both constituent moduli.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly identifies that the reported value of 2.5 GPa is incorrect and calculates the proper longitudinal modulus using the rule of mixtures as 139.2 GPa (230 × 0.60 + 3 × 0.40 = 138 + 1.2 = 139.2 GPa). This directly addresses the inconsistency that a composite with 60 vol% fibers at 230 GPa cannot have a longitudinal modulus of 2.5 GPa, which falls far below both constituent moduli.
